A quieter approach
to modern beauty.

© 2026 Infineo. Demo website only. Built by Infineo

This is a demo project, not a real salon's website. It has been built by Infineo (infineodevs) to showcase, to salon businesses across the Gulf, what kind of website Infineo can design and build for them.

All photography shown on this site is placeholder imagery used purely to demonstrate layout, composition, and how a finished website would look with real photos in place — it is not photography of an actual salon, staff, or clients. When a real client is onboarded, every image is replaced with their own photography without changing the design.

This demo also includes a working admin dashboard (booking list, status management, search/filter) reachable only for demonstration — it runs on the browser's local storage with no real backend or authentication, and exists purely to show how a booking-management panel would function. A production build for a real client would use a proper secured backend, authentication, and database.
